name: Pulse Music v4.2.6 - 100% Accurate Spotify Playback, Canvas Videos & Track Details
body:
# Pulse Music v4.2.6 - 100% Accurate Spotify Playback, Canvas Videos & Track Details

Official multi-platform release and global OTA update for **Android**, **Windows**, **Orion Store**, **F-Droid**, **Obtainium**, and **Web**.

---

### 🎯 100% Accurate Spotify Song & Details Matching
- **Authoritative Spotify Track Enrichment**: Resolves exact track title, full artist credits, album/movie soundtrack name, and duration directly via Spotify track endpoints before matching streams or metadata.
- **Transliteration, Dual-Title & Soundtrack Disambiguation**: Handles regional spelling variants (e.g., *Halamathi Habibo* ↔ *Halamithi Habibo*), dual titles (*Arabic Kuthu - Halamithi Habibo*), and movie/album context (*Beast*), while strictly rejecting ringtones, BGMs, unrequested remixes, and unrelated artists.
- **Complete Song Details for Spotify Tracks**: Populates full artist credits, album name, duration, and high-res artwork for Spotify tracks in the info sheet and radio seeding instead of failing on YouTube-only IDs.

### 🎬 Exact Song-Locked Canvas Videos & Spotify Lyrics
- **Direct Spotify Canvas Lookup First**: Queries Canvas directly by authentic Spotify track ID (`sp_track:<id>`) before searching, and validates all fallback Canvas, Apple Music Motion, and Spotify Lyrics candidates using strict title, artist, album, and duration verification so unrelated Canvas videos or wrong lyrics are never displayed.

### 🧹 Automatic Legacy Cache Repair & CDN Safety
- **Clean Upgrade Migration**: Automatically clears stale pre-v4.2.6 `sp_track:` ExoPlayer audio caches, cached formats, Canvas URLs, and song info rows once on upgrade, and fixes format-cache `&cpn=` URL handling on direct CDN streams.
